🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Barcelona are monitoring two 17-year-old attacking talents in the Bundesliga: Mathis Albert of Borussia Dortmund and Wael Mohya of Borussia Mönchengladbach. The interest is part of the club’s strategy to recruit promising young prospects. [@jbatalla7] #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Joan Laporta: “We’ll end up charging Real Madrid royalties for using our name. They should stop talking about us. They’re obsessed with Barça.” #fcblive

🚨🎖️| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Florentino Pérez will NOT retract his allegations against Barcelona regarding the Negreira case. He also failed to attend the hearing, allowing Barça to proceed with a criminal complaint against him for slander. #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola: "What makes me different from other coaches? MESSI." #fcblive 🐐

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola: "When I arrived at Barcelona, the polls only gave me 3 or 4% support. NOBODY wanted me. I was coming straight from the reserve team while the first team was struggling. ​I thought to myself: 'Perfect. Nobody wants me. That's the best thing that could happen.'" #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola on whether anyone will ever reach Lionel Messi's level: "NO, I don't think so. I don't think I'll see it in my lifetime. Maintaining that level for 15 or 20 years, every three days, with that BEAUTY and difficulty. I just don't see it." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola: "Which club i enjoyed managing most? Barcelona has been SPECIAL.​ I have a very deep emotional connection to Barça. I was a ball boy there, Barcelona means a great deal to me, and that's where my journey began." #fcblive ❤️

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola on which current player can become one of football's all-time greats: "Lamine Yamal, I think he has something different, something SPECIAL. He also has that desire to be the BEST, and that's a great quality." #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Pep Guardiola: "Coaching Messi? Trust me, I've NEVER seen another player like him capable of scoring 3 goals and registering 3 assists every 3 days. Very few can sustain that level of consistency, yet he delivered it in both official matches and training. In four years of training sessions, I can't recall him losing a single small-sided game. He possessed that fierce competitive edge, and I believe that's what truly set him apart." #fcblive 🐐
🚨🎖| 𝐉𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐈𝐍: Òscar Gistau will be included in the squad against Sabah FK. [@scapde_45] #fcblive

🔙 | On this day in 2012, Barcelona made history by fielding an all-La Masia XI for the first time in a 4-0 win over Levante. It wasn’t the starting XI, though. Martín Montoya came on for the injured Dani Alves in the first half, completing 11 academy graduates on the pitch. A historic moment for the club!  #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Joan Laporta: “They (Madrid) have gone two years without winning anything, and now they’re even considering SELLING a part of their club. They should be explaining their project and answering questions about their own situation, just as we do at Barça, instead of constantly talking about us.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Joan Laporta: “The conciliation hearing is a step that precedes the filing of a criminal complaint. What we wanted to do was give them an OPPORTUNITY to correct their statements. Sometimes people make mistakes in their statements or go too far with their words. The conciliation hearing gives them a chance to correct themselves and retract those remarks.” #fcblive
